slides.headline: 40 Amazon Leo Satellites Lost as Vulcan Rocket Fails

slides.stat_label: Into the Flight, ULA's Vulcan Rocket Failed
bullets: Lifted off 11:10 PM IST Sunday from Florida
ULA's first total mission failure in 20 years
Cause not yet known; ULA is investigating
slides.credit_line: Sources: ULA, Ars Technica, The Verge, SpaceNews

slides.stat_label: More Vulcan Launches Amazon Has Booked
bullets: Vulcan was to carry about half of Leo
Under 400 Leo satellites in orbit; 3,000+ planned
Amazon's stated target: service later this year
slides.credit_line: Sources: Amazon, Ars Technica, The Verge

slides.stat_label: Amazon Leo Applied in India. Still No Licence
bullets: Starlink, OneWeb and Jio Satellite already hold licences
None has started commercial service in India
Security clearance and spectrum pricing still pending
slides.credit_line: Sources: Communications Today, Digit, Angel One, TelecomTalk
